name: simply_supported_point
source: Euler-Bernoulli + Timoshenko simply supported beam, central point load: delta = P L^3/(48 E I) + P L/(4 kappa G A) = 0.446 + 0.015 mm, span 80 mm, knife-edge lines at the bottom edges of both end faces.
notes: manual_pins apply textbook knife-edge supports: the region system always pins >= 2 node planes (cell granularity), which adds ~2.4x artificial clamping stiffness here — documented limitation, see docs/fem-verification.md. Solver accuracy vs theory is ~5% under this BC.
